home.empty_dashboard_subtitle: It looks like your collection is empty. Here's how to get started:
home.empty_dash_1_desc: Use the 'Sync Discord' button in the sidebar to connect and download schematics from your friends automatically.
home.empty_dash_2_desc: If you already have .litematic files, drag them directly to this window or press the 'Import' button at the top right.
home.empty_dash_3_desc: Click on any imported schematic to open the interactive 3D viewer and see the required materials list.
home.sync_help_title: ❔ How do I get this data?
home.sync_help_token_1: 1. Log in to Discord from your web browser (Chrome, Edge, etc).
home.sync_help_token_2: 2. Press F12 to open the developer tools.
home.sync_help_token_3: 3. Go to the 'Application' tab and then to 'Local Storage'.
home.sync_help_token_4: 4. Find the 'token' key, copy it, and paste it above (without quotes).
home.sync_help_token_warn: ⚠️ WARNING: Never share this token with ANYONE. Your token is only stored locally on your computer.
home.sync_help_server_desc: You can paste the server's numeric ID (by enabling developer mode in Discord and right-clicking the server icon) or simply the invite link (e.g., discord.gg/myserver).

settings.discord_sync_desc: Discord configuration (Token and Server) is managed directly from the 'Sync Discord' button in the sidebar.
settings.danger_zone_desc: Danger zone. These actions are irreversible.
